name: Thermal Analysis Agent
description: Specialist agent for thermal analysis of nuclear reactor materials. Evaluates thermal fatigue, creep behavior, thermal conductivity degradation, and temperature distribution effects on material performance.

skills.name: Analyze Thermal Effects
skills.description: Comprehensive thermal analysis including thermal fatigue cycles, creep evaluation, and thermal stress assessment
skills.usage_notes: Use for materials experiencing temperature cycling or sustained high temperatures
skills.output_format: JSON with thermal damage assessment, fatigue life, creep rates, and safety factors

skills.name: Calculate Thermal Fatigue
skills.description: Evaluate thermal cycling damage, calculate fatigue life consumption, and predict remaining cycles to failure
skills.usage_notes: Use for components undergoing frequent temperature changes (startup/shutdown cycles)
skills.output_format: JSON with cycle count, damage fraction, remaining life, and inspection recommendations

skills.name: Assess Creep
skills.description: Analyze high-temperature creep behavior, strain accumulation rates, and time-to-rupture predictions
skills.usage_notes: Critical for high-temperature components like steam generator tubing and piping
skills.output_format: JSON with creep rate, accumulated strain, rupture life estimate, and compliance status
